input.rationale: Searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate" and "liability" return no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement, and the General Provisions (Sections 10.1–10.8) contain none. HDI hosts and operates the Site, collects consumer orders and handles Company Content and user information (Sections 1.4, 1.5, 8.1), so the rule is engaged and the absence of any cover for a vendor processing personal data is walk-away territory. We insert a single preferred-level Section 10.9 carrying CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where HDI processes Company data, statutory workers' compensation and certificates on request; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is available if HDI pushes back.

proposal.summary: Insert an insurance covenant for HDI in the General Provisions section
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though HDI hosts the Site and processes Company order and customer data, so we have added a short Section 10.9 requiring commercial general liability (USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate), errors and omissions (USD 2M), cyber and privacy cover (USD 5M) where HDI processes Company data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. We can fall back to E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M if needed.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
